companies.name: Broadcom Inc.
companies.reason: Broadcom is trending on the back of strong AI-chip demand and a fresh product push around VMware Private AI Cloud. Recent news flow also highlighted its fiscal Q3 2026 results, with the company positioning itself as a key infrastructure player for enterprise AI deployment and custom accelerators.
companies.popularity: High — Broadcom is showing up repeatedly in business and tech coverage, with investor attention focused on AI revenue growth, VMware integration, and large-hyperscaler demand.
companies.sentiment: Positive — the news tone is upbeat, emphasizing revenue momentum, AI monetization, and strategic product expansion, though some investors remain cautious about guidance and valuation.
companies.expert_opinion: Experts view Broadcom as one of the clearest beneficiaries of the AI infrastructure buildout because it combines custom AI silicon, networking, and infrastructure software. The VMware Private AI Cloud launch strengthens its enterprise story and broadens its AI monetization beyond chips.
companies.historical_performance: Broadcom has had a strong multi-year run driven by semiconductor strength, networking leadership, and software expansion. Recent reports point to AI semiconductor revenue surging well above prior-year levels, reinforcing a history of executing through cyclical swings and adapting into higher-margin AI infrastructure.

companies.name: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.
companies.reason: AMD is trending because of continued AI infrastructure momentum, including strong data-center results, rack-scale AI positioning, and market focus on its Helios AI platform and server CPU/GPU expansion. The company remains in the news as a challenger in AI chips and accelerated computing.
companies.popularity: High — AMD is one of the most discussed semiconductor names in recent tech news, especially around AI-capex, data-center growth, and competitive positioning versus Nvidia and Broadcom.
companies.sentiment: Mixed-to-positive — investors are encouraged by record data-center growth and AI opportunities, but reaction has also reflected high expectations and concern that the stock must keep delivering to justify the narrative.
companies.expert_opinion: Analysts generally see AMD as a credible long-term AI infrastructure winner, particularly if it can convert product momentum into large-scale deployments. The bullish thesis centers on data-center diversification and improving AI relevance, while the main risk remains execution against dominant competitors.
companies.historical_performance: AMD has historically been a strong cyclical growth story, with major share gains during periods of server and PC share capture. In the current AI cycle, its data-center revenue has become the main growth engine, and recent earnings have shown the company scaling into a larger AI role after years of building platform breadth.

companies.name: Palantir Technologies Inc.
companies.reason: Palantir is trending due to a steady stream of AI-platform and defense contract news, including partnerships with Shield AI and Zeta Global, plus deliveries of TITAN systems to the U.S. Army. The company remains highly visible because its AI software story is resonating across both government and commercial markets.
companies.popularity: High — Palantir is one of the most talked-about software names in tech news, especially among investors tracking AI software, defense tech, and government AI adoption.
companies.sentiment: Positive but volatile — news is constructive on growth, contracts, and enterprise AI adoption, but sentiment is tempered by valuation concerns and a history of sharp moves around earnings and guidance.
companies.expert_opinion: Experts tend to see Palantir as a high-quality AI software operator with real deployment traction in defense and enterprise workflows. The upside case rests on expanding AIP adoption and durable contracts; the main debate is whether growth can sustain current valuation levels.
companies.historical_performance: Palantir has transitioned from a controversial data-analytics name into a high-growth AI software stock, with strong revenue acceleration and improving margins. Historical performance has been volatile, but the company has consistently gained relevance as investors re-rate software tied to real AI usage rather than pure concept exposure.
